name: Seed learner v1.2 held-out memory retrieval gate draft
description: Independent held-out synthetic learner for memory retrieval gate v1.2. It uses new learner identity, new problem slugs, and low-confidence active facts designed to surface when MEMORY_MIN_RETRIEVAL_CONFIDENCE is disabled.

learnerProfile.interviewGoal: New-grad coding interview prep with short, evidence-grounded coaching
explanationStyle: Name the invariant in plain words
outputPreferences: Give one runnable micro-step before theory
Default to Python examples unless I ask for C++
Keep the first reply concise and do not paste a full solution
Use Chinese for casual coaching questions

practicedProblems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

episodes.title: Contains Duplicate review: membership check after add
episodes.summary: The learner added the current number into seen before checking membership, so Contains Duplicate returned true immediately on a unique list. The blocker was hash table membership order, not lack of a set idea.

review.userState: I know a set should help, but my result is always true.
review.userQuestion: Why does Contains Duplicate say [1,2,3] has a duplicate?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The code inserts x before asking whether x was already present.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Keep the set approach and move the membership check before seen.add(x).

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 根因是顺序反了：你先 `seen.add(x)`，再问 `x in seen`，所以第一个数也会被当成重复。下一步只改顺序：先查、再加入。

episodes.title: Contains Duplicate repair: check before add
episodes.summary: The learner repaired Contains Duplicate by checking x in seen before adding x, and the visible unique and duplicate cases passed. This contradicted the earlier casual belief that sorting was the only workable route.

review.userState: I moved the check before add.
review.userQuestion: Does this set version look okay on the visible cases?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The set membership order is now correct on visible cases.
diagnosis.coachSummary: The visible evidence supports the check-before-add pattern.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这次可见用例过了：`if x in seen` 放在 `seen.add(x)` 前面，避免把当前数误判成旧数。仍然只代表当前可见用例，不等于 hidden-test AC。

episodes.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence review: start only at x-1 gaps
episodes.summary: The learner used a set and only started counting when x-1 was absent, avoiding repeated sequence scans. This is a reusable hash table sequence-start skill.

review.userState: I tried the set start-point trick.
review.userQuestion: Can I reuse this set trick for sequence problems?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The learner correctly used set membership to avoid duplicate scans.
diagnosis.coachSummary: This start-point invariant can transfer to other hash-table sequence tasks.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这个 set 思路是可复用的：只从 `x - 1` 不存在的位置开跑，就不会重复扫同一段连续序列。

episodes.title: Product Except Self review: prefix and suffix include self
episodes.summary: The learner multiplied nums[i] into both prefix and suffix before writing answer[i], so Product Except Self included the current element in its own product.

review.userState: The prefix/suffix idea feels right but the numbers are off.
review.userQuestion: Why does [1,2,3,4] give products that are too large?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: prefix and suffix are updated before answer[i], so nums[i] is included.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Write the current outside product first, then multiply the running product by nums[i].

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 问题是 `ans[i]` 写得太晚：你先把 `nums[i]` 乘进 left/right，再写答案，所以它把自己也算进去了。下一步把“写 ans”放在更新 running product 之前。

episodes.title: Find Minimum repair history: returned mid after loop
episodes.summary: The learner once returned mid after the rotated-array binary-search loop, which picked a stale midpoint rather than the converged left boundary.

review.userState: I think mid points at the minimum when the loop ends.
review.userQuestion: Why is return mid wrong here?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: mid is stale after the loop and does not represent the final boundary.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Return nums[left] after convergence, not nums[mid].

review.coachReplyMarkdown: `mid` 是循环里某一轮的临时值，循环结束后真正收敛的是 `left/right`。这类写法要返回 `nums[left]`。

episodes.title: Find Minimum repair: return left after convergence
episodes.summary: The learner repaired the old return-mid mistake by returning nums[left] after the loop, and visible rotated cases passed.

review.userState: I changed the final return to left.
review.userQuestion: Does returning left fix the old mid issue?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The final answer now uses the converged boundary.
diagnosis.coachSummary: The old return-mid blocker is resolved on visible cases.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这次修的是旧问题：循环收敛到 `l`，所以 `return nums[l]`。当前可见用例支持这个边界写法。

episodes.title: Find Minimum review: discarded mid that could be minimum
episodes.summary: In a later Find Minimum attempt, the learner used r = mid - 1 when nums[mid] <= nums[r], discarding mid even though mid could still be the minimum.

review.userState: The return is left now, but one rotated case still fails.
review.userQuestion: Why does r = mid - 1 lose the minimum?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: When nums[mid] <= nums[r], mid remains a valid minimum candidate.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Use r = mid, not r = mid - 1, in the sorted-right branch.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这次不是旧的 `return mid`，而是你在右半边有序时把 `mid` 本身丢掉了。`nums[mid]` 可能就是最小值，所以这一支要 `r = mid`。

episodes.title: Koko Eating Bananas review: answer-space lower bound starts at zero
episodes.summary: The learner started Koko's binary search speed at 0, which made the feasibility check divide by zero. The blocker was answer-space bounds for binary search.

review.userState: I know binary search on answer, but the first run crashes.
review.userQuestion: Why does Koko crash when speed starts at 0?

firstFailedCase.label: zero speed
firstFailedCase.error: integer division or modulo by zero

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The answer-space lower bound allows an invalid speed of zero.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Set lo = 1 because speed must be at least one banana per hour.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 二分答案前先给答案域定合法范围：Koko 的速度不能是 0，所以 `lo` 要从 1 开始。否则 `ok(0)` 会直接除零。

episodes.title: Permutation in String review: counts not balanced when window slides
episodes.summary: The learner added the incoming character but forgot to decrement the outgoing character, so the sliding-window counts drifted away from the fixed window.

review.userState: I made a fixed-size window, but the counts don't match.
review.userQuestion: Permutation in String: why does eidbaooo miss ba?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The outgoing character is not removed when the fixed window advances.
diagnosis.coachSummary: For each right step after size k, decrement s2[i-k] before comparing counts.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 固定窗口不是只加右边字符，也要把左边滑出去的字符减掉。下一步只补 `out = s2[i-k]` 的 decrement，再比较两个 Counter。

episodes.title: Character Replacement review: recomputed max frequency as exact window state
episodes.summary: The learner tried to recompute max frequency after every shrink and tied it to the exact current window, making the shrink condition unstable. The stable-window invariant was the blocker.

review.userState: I keep recalculating the max count and the window jumps around.
review.userQuestion: Why is my Character Replacement window shrinking too much?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The best length is updated only inside shrink and the max-frequency invariant is unstable.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Track max frequency monotonically and update best after the shrink loop.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: `best` 不该只在收缩时更新；这题要先保证窗口合法，再在每轮右扩后更新答案。`max_freq` 可以作为历史最大值维护，不必每次缩窗后倒算。

episodes.title: Valid Palindrome review: alphanumeric cleanup with two pointers
episodes.summary: The learner correctly skipped non-alphanumeric characters and compared lowercase characters from both ends. This is a reliable two-pointers cleanup skill.

review.userState: I tried to skip punctuation before comparing.
review.userQuestion: Can I trust this two-pointer cleanup pattern?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The learner correctly traced both pointer skips before comparison.
diagnosis.coachSummary: This boundary-trace skill is reusable for two-pointer string scans.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这个小步骤是可靠的：先各自跳过非字母数字，再统一 lowercase 比较。你已经能把双指针边界按顺序走清楚。

episodes.title: 3Sum review: duplicate triplets not skipped
episodes.summary: The learner sorted the array and used two pointers, but did not skip duplicate anchors or duplicate left/right values, so 3Sum returned repeated triplets.

review.userState: I can find sums, but duplicates keep appearing.

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: Duplicate anchors and pointer values are not skipped after recording a triplet.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Skip equal nums[i] anchors and move l/r past repeated values after each hit.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 你的双指针找和没错，重复来自“命中后没有跳过相同值”。下一步只加两处去重：跳过重复 `i`，命中后把 `l/r` 移到下一个不同值。

episodes.title: Min Stack review: duplicate minimum pop loses min state
episodes.summary: The learner only pushed to min_stack when x was strictly smaller than the current min, so duplicate minimum values were not tracked and pop lost the correct min.

review.userState: My MinStack fails when the minimum appears twice.
review.userQuestion: Why does getMin change after popping one duplicate min?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: Equal minimum values are not recorded in the auxiliary stack.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Use <= when pushing to min_stack, or store min counts.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 你只在 `val < current_min` 时记录最小值，第二个 1 没进 `mins`。pop 掉一个 1 后，系统以为最小值回到 2。最小改法：push 时用 `<=`。

episodes.title: Evaluate RPN chat: integer division truncates toward zero
episodes.summary: The learner asked whether Python // and C++ / behave the same for negative Reverse Polish Notation division. The unresolved API confusion is that LeetCode expects integer division truncated toward zero.

userMessages: Evaluate RPN 里如果是 -3 / 2，Python // 和 C++ / 是不是一样？LeetCode 到底要怎么截断？
assistantMessages: 这题要向 0 截断：C++ int 除法天然符合；Python 不能直接用 // 处理负数，可以用 int(a / b) 或显式符号处理。

episodes.title: Validate BST review: compared only with direct parent
episodes.summary: The learner checked each node only against its direct parent, so a deep right-subtree value that violated the root bound was accepted.

review.userState: My recursion compares child with parent, but one tree slips through.

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The check does not carry ancestor lower/upper bounds.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Pass a low/high range through DFS instead of comparing only parent-child.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: BST 的限制来自所有祖先，不只是父节点。`3` 在 `5` 的右子树里，虽然小于父节点 4，却违反了根节点的下界。下一步给 DFS 带 `low/high`。

episodes.title: Course Schedule review: indegree queue skill
episodes.summary: The learner correctly modeled prerequisites with indegree counts and a queue of zero-indegree courses. This is a reusable graph topological-sort skill.

review.userState: I used indegree and a queue.
review.userQuestion: Is this topological sort pattern reusable?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The learner used a correct indegree queue invariant.
diagnosis.coachSummary: This pattern transfers to graph prerequisite scheduling tasks.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这个拓扑排序模式可以复用：`indegree == 0` 的课先进队，弹出后再减少邻居入度。关键是不把 DFS visited 和入度队列混成一个状态。

episodes.title: Rotting Oranges review: minutes increment per cell instead of per layer
episodes.summary: The learner incremented minutes for every rotten orange popped from the queue, so the BFS time counted cells rather than layers.

review.userState: My BFS rots all oranges but the minutes are too large.
review.userQuestion: Why does Rotting Oranges count 6 minutes instead of 4?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The BFS increments time per popped cell instead of per level.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Process one queue layer per minute and increment after the layer spreads.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: BFS 的分钟数是一层一层扩散，不是每弹出一个橘子加 1。下一步固定当前队列长度，处理完这一层后再 `minutes += 1`。

episodes.title: House Robber review: rolling state overwritten before using previous best
episodes.summary: The learner updated prev1 before computing the new House Robber state, so the recurrence reused the current-house value as if it were the previous best.

review.userState: I tried rolling variables but the result is too high.
review.userQuestion: House Robber: why does [2,7,9,3,1] give an impossible total?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: prev2 is overwritten with the newly computed prev1 instead of the old prev1.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Compute new_best first, then shift prev2 = old prev1 and prev1 = new_best.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 滚动 DP 要先保存“旧状态”。你先改了 `prev1`，再让 `prev2 = prev1`，两个变量就变成同一个新值。下一步用临时变量 `new_best` 再整体平移。

episodes.title: Word Break review: ignores prefix reachability
episodes.summary: The learner marked dp[i] true whenever s[j:i] was in the dictionary, without checking that dp[j] was reachable, so unreachable suffix matches leaked into the answer.

review.userState: I check every dictionary word ending at i, but a false case passes.

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The transition ignores whether the prefix before j is reachable.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Require dp[j] and s[j:i] in words before setting dp[i].

review.coachReplyMarkdown: `s[j:i]` 是词还不够，前半段 `s[:j]` 也必须已经能拆。下一步把条件改成 `if dp[j] and s[j:i] in words`。

episodes.title: Low-confidence DP aside: wondered whether DP can be greedy
episodes.summary: The learner casually asked once whether dynamic programming problems can usually be solved greedily, without submitting code or repeating the behavior. This is intentionally thin evidence.

userMessages: 我只是随口问一下，DP 题是不是很多都能先贪心试试？我还没写代码。
assistantMessages: 可以先把这个当成问题，不要马上当成你的固定弱点；等有代码证据再判断。

episodes.summary: The learner casually asked once whether two pointers only works on sorted arrays, but there was no repeated mistake or code evidence. This is intentionally thin evidence.

assistantMessages: 先记成一个待澄清问题，不把它当成稳定错误；看具体题的 invariant。

episodes.summary: The learner casually wondered once whether sliding-window problems are always fixed size, without repeated examples or code evidence. This is intentionally thin evidence.

notes: Agent-drafted held-out set; humanReviewStatus stays pending until manual audit.
All practiced problem slugs are distinct from memory retrieval v1.1's practiced problem list.
Low-confidence facts are active DB rows after reinforce+weaken arbitration and settle at confidence 0.38, below the default 0.45 retrieval floor.
The low-confidence tags deliberately use algorithm prefixes that match current problem tags so disabling the floor can surface them.
Preference memory is evaluated through learnerProfile output preference markers, not as expected L2 fact retrieval.
limitations: This is a synthetic closed-book held-out draft and should not be treated as approved gate ground truth until human review.
Episode retrieval remains lexical FTS-only in the eval runner unless embeddings are configured elsewhere; queries include explicit English anchors for target episodes.
No real LLM calls are used by the seed step; all memory writes are fixture-only arbitration paths.
